name: The Hundred
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent at tabletop position, shins parallel to the floor.
Curl your head and shoulders off the mat, engaging your abdominals.
Extend your arms alongside your body, hovering them a few inches off the mat.
Pump your arms up and down in small controlled movements, inhaling for 5 pumps and exhaling for 5 pumps.
Complete 10 full breath cycles for a total of 100 pumps.

name: Roll Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead, legs together and straight.
Inhale and bring your arms toward the ceiling, tucking your chin slightly.
Exhale and peel your spine off the mat one vertebra at a time, reaching forward toward your toes.
Inhale at the top, sitting tall.
Exhale and reverse the movement, rolling back down to the mat with control.

name: Roll Over
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.
Inhale to prepare, then exhale and lift your hips off the mat, rolling your legs overhead until they are parallel to the floor.
Open your legs to shoulder width and flex your feet.
Slowly roll your spine back down to the mat one vertebra at a time, keeping legs extended.
Close your legs together at the bottom and repeat.

name: Single Leg Circle
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the mat and the other leg reaching straight up to the ceiling.
Keep your arms pressed into the mat by your sides for stability.
Circle the raised leg across the body, down, around, and back up to the starting position.
Complete 5 circles in one direction, then reverse for 5 circles.
Switch legs and repeat.

name: Rolling Like a Ball
instructions: Sit at the front of your mat with knees bent and drawn toward your chest.
Hold onto your shins or ankles, lifting your feet off the mat and balancing on your tailbone.
Tuck your chin and round your spine into a tight ball shape.
Inhale and roll back to your shoulder blades, keeping the rounded shape.
Exhale and roll back up to the balanced starting position without letting your feet touch the mat.

name: Single Leg Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Bring one knee into your chest, placing the outside hand on the ankle and the inside hand on the knee.
Extend the other leg out at a 45-degree angle from the floor.
Switch legs in a smooth scissoring motion, coordinating hand placement with each switch.
Continue alternating for 8 to 10 repetitions per side, keeping the torso stable.

name: Double Leg Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees drawn into your chest, head and shoulders curled off the mat.
Inhale and simultaneously extend your arms overhead and your legs out at a 45-degree angle.
Exhale and circle your arms around while drawing your knees back into your chest.
Keep your lower back pressed into the mat throughout the movement.
Repeat for 8 to 10 repetitions.

name: Scissors
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend both legs toward the ceiling.
Lower one leg toward the floor while pulling the other leg gently toward your face with both hands.
Switch legs with a quick pulse, catching the opposite ankle.
Continue alternating in a scissoring motion for 8 to 10 repetitions per side.

name: Lower Lift
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended straight up toward the ceiling, head and shoulders curled off the mat.
Place your hands behind your head for support.
Inhale and slowly lower both legs toward the floor as far as you can while keeping your back flat on the mat.
Exhale and lift both legs back up to the starting position.
Repeat for 8 to 10 repetitions.

name: Criss Cross
instructions: Lie on your back with knees in tabletop position, hands behind your head, head and shoulders curled up.
Extend one leg out at a 45-degree angle while rotating your torso to bring the opposite elbow toward the bent knee.
Hold the rotation for a moment, deepening the twist.
Switch sides, extending the other leg and rotating to the opposite knee.
Alternate for 8 to 10 repetitions per side.

name: Spine Stretch Forward
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended in front of you, slightly wider than hip-width apart, feet flexed.
Extend your arms in front of you at shoulder height.
Inhale to sit taller, then exhale and round forward from the top of your head, reaching past your toes.
Articulate through the spine as you curl forward, scooping the abdominals in.
Inhale and stack your spine back up to the tall seated position.

name: Open Leg Rocker
instructions: Sit on your mat and balance on your sit bones with legs extended in a V shape, holding onto your ankles or calves.
Maintain a rounded C-curve in your spine.
Inhale and roll back to your shoulder blades, keeping the leg position steady.
Exhale and roll back up to the balanced V position.
Repeat for 6 to 8 repetitions, never rolling onto the neck.

name: Corkscrew
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.
Keep your legs together and circle them to the right, down, to the left, and back up to center.
Use your abdominals to control the movement, keeping your shoulders and hips stable.
Reverse the direction of the circle.
Complete 3 to 5 circles in each direction.

name: Saw
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, feet flexed, arms extended to the sides at shoulder height.
Inhale and rotate your torso to the right.
Exhale and reach your left hand past your right little toe in a sawing motion, rounding forward.
Inhale and return to the upright rotated position.
Exhale and return to center. Repeat on the other side.

name: Swan Dive
instructions: Lie face down with hands placed under your shoulders, legs together.
Press up into a back extension, lifting your chest high off the mat.
Release your hands and rock forward onto your chest, lifting your legs behind you.
Rock back, lifting your chest and lowering your legs.
Continue the rocking motion for 5 to 8 repetitions, using momentum and control.

name: Single Leg Kick
instructions: Lie face down propped up on your forearms, elbows directly under shoulders, legs extended behind you.
Lift your chest and gaze slightly forward, engaging your abdominals.
Bend one knee and pulse the heel toward your glute with two quick kicks.
Extend the leg back down and switch to the other leg.
Alternate for 8 to 10 repetitions per side.

name: Double Leg Kick
instructions: Lie face down with your head turned to one side, hands clasped behind your lower back.
Bend both knees and pulse your heels toward your glutes three times.
Extend your legs and arms behind you while lifting your chest off the mat into a back extension.
Lower back down, turning your head to the opposite side.
Repeat for 6 to 8 repetitions, alternating the head turn.

name: Neck Pull
instructions: Lie on your back with legs hip-width apart, feet flexed, hands behind your head.
Inhale and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Exhale and continue rolling up and over your legs, rounding forward.
Inhale and stack your spine to a tall seated position.
Exhale and hinge back with a flat back, then curl down to the mat one vertebra at a time.

name: Shoulder Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the mat hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
Peel your hips off the mat, rolling up through the spine until you form a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Extend one leg straight up to the ceiling.
Lower the extended leg down to knee level, then kick it back up. Repeat 5 times.
Place the foot back down, switch legs and repeat, then roll the spine back down.

name: Spine Twist
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended together in front of you, feet flexed, arms extended to the sides at shoulder height.
Inhale to grow taller through the spine.
Exhale and rotate your torso to the right with two small pulses, keeping hips stable.
Inhale and return to center.
Exhale and rotate to the left. Repeat 4 to 6 times per side.

name: Jackknife
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, legs extended at a 45-degree angle from the floor.
Swing your legs overhead to a rollover position, parallel to the floor.
Press into your arms and lift your legs straight up to the ceiling, creating a vertical line from shoulders to toes.
Hold briefly at the top, engaging your powerhouse.
Slowly roll your spine back down to the mat with control, lowering your legs to the starting angle.

name: Side Kick Front Back
instructions: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line, head resting on your bottom arm.
Place your top hand on the mat in front of your chest for support.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Swing the top leg forward with a double pulse kick, then sweep it back behind you.
Keep your torso completely still throughout. Repeat 8 to 10 times per side.

name: Side Kick Up Down
instructions: Lie on your side in the side kick starting position.
Turn your top leg out slightly from the hip so the knee faces the ceiling.
Kick the top leg up toward the ceiling with energy.
Resist on the way down, lowering the leg with control.
Repeat 8 to 10 times, then switch sides.

name: Side Kick Circles
instructions: Lie on your side in the side kick starting position with your top leg at hip height.
Draw small circles with your top leg, keeping the movement controlled.
Complete 8 circles in one direction.
Reverse the direction for 8 more circles.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Teaser
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended at a 45-degree angle, arms reaching overhead.
Inhale to prepare, then exhale and simultaneously roll your upper body off the mat while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs, balancing on your sit bones.
Hold the V position briefly.
Exhale and slowly roll everything back down to the starting position with control.

name: Swimming
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs straight behind you.
Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the mat simultaneously.
Begin alternating opposite arm and leg lifts in a flutter motion, as if swimming.
Inhale for 5 counts and exhale for 5 counts while maintaining the flutter.
Continue for 2 to 3 breath cycles.

name: Leg Pull Front
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lift one leg off the mat, reaching it straight back and up.
Rock back on the supporting foot, pressing your heel toward the mat.
Rock forward to the starting position and lower the leg.
Alternate legs for 5 to 8 repetitions per side.

name: Leg Pull Back
instructions: Sit with legs extended in front of you, hands placed on the mat behind your hips with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips off the mat to form a reverse plank, creating a straight line from head to heels.
Kick one leg straight up toward the ceiling without dropping your hips.
Lower the leg with control and switch sides.
Repeat 5 times per leg.

name: Side Bend
instructions: Sit on one hip with your legs stacked and slightly bent, bottom hand placed on the mat directly under your shoulder.
Inhale and press up into a side plank, lifting your hips and extending your top arm overhead in an arc.
Create a long curved line from fingertips to feet.
Exhale and lower back down with control to the starting position.
Repeat 4 to 6 times, then switch sides.

name: Boomerang
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended, one ankle crossed over the other, arms by your sides.
Roll back to your shoulder blades, lifting your legs overhead.
Switch the cross of your ankles while overhead.
Roll back up to the Teaser V position, then reach your arms behind you and clasp your hands.
Round forward over your legs, stretching your clasped hands up behind you.

name: Seal
instructions: Sit on your mat and balance on your tailbone with knees open, feet together.
Thread your arms inside your legs and wrap your hands around the outside of your ankles.
Clap your feet together three times like a seal.
Roll back to your shoulder blades, clap three times at the top.
Roll back up to the balanced position and repeat 8 to 10 times.

name: Mermaid Stretch
instructions: Sit with both legs folded to one side, holding your ankle with the bottom hand.
Extend the top arm up and over, reaching toward the opposite side in a lateral stretch.
Feel a deep stretch along the side of your body.
Return to the upright position.
Repeat 3 to 4 times, then switch sides.

name: Pilates Push Up
instructions: Stand tall at the back of your mat with arms by your sides.
Nod your chin and roll down through the spine, walking your hands out to a plank position.
Perform 3 to 5 push-ups with elbows close to your body, lowering with control.
Walk your hands back toward your feet.
Roll up through the spine to the standing position.

name: Swan
instructions: Lie face down with hands placed under your shoulders, elbows bent and close to your body.
Press into your hands and slowly lift your chest off the mat, extending through the upper back.
Keep your hips and legs pressed into the mat.
Hold the extension for a breath.
Lower back down with control. Repeat 5 to 8 times.

name: Hip Circles
instructions: Sit with your hands on the mat behind you, fingers pointing forward, legs extended up at a diagonal.
Circle both legs to the right, down, to the left, and back up.
Keep your torso lifted and stable throughout the circle.
Reverse the direction after 5 circles.
Complete 5 circles in each direction.

name: Control Balance
instructions: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead into a rollover position.
Hold one ankle with both hands while extending the other leg straight up to the ceiling.
Pull the held leg toward you with a double pulse.
Switch legs by scissoring them and catching the other ankle.
Continue alternating for 6 to 8 repetitions per side.

name: Reformer Footwork Parallel
instructions: Lie on the reformer carriage with your head on the headrest, feet placed parallel on the foot bar hip-width apart.
Press out through your feet to extend your legs fully, moving the carriage.
Keep your spine neutral and abdominals engaged throughout.
Slowly bend your knees to return the carriage to the starting position.
Repeat for 10 repetitions.

name: Reformer Footwork V Position
instructions: Lie on the reformer with heels together and toes apart on the foot bar in a small V position.
Press out to extend your legs fully, squeezing your inner thighs together.
Maintain the V position of the feet throughout the movement.
Return the carriage with control by bending your knees.
Repeat for 10 repetitions.

name: Reformer Footwork on Heels
instructions: Lie on the reformer with your heels on the foot bar, toes flexed toward you.
Press out through your heels to fully extend your legs.
Keep your feet flexed and ankles stable throughout.
Return with control, keeping heels firmly on the bar.
Repeat for 10 repetitions.

name: The Elephant
instructions: Stand on the reformer carriage with your hands on the foot bar, heels pressing against the shoulder blocks.
Round your spine into a deep C-curve, drawing your abdominals in and up.
Use your abdominals to press the carriage back a few inches.
Pull the carriage back in using your core, not your arms.
Repeat for 8 to 10 repetitions.

name: Long Stretch
instructions: Place your hands on the foot bar and feet against the shoulder blocks in a plank position on the reformer.
Maintain a long straight line from head to heels.
Push the carriage back by pressing through your arms while holding the plank.
Pull the carriage forward by engaging your core and shoulders.
Repeat for 6 to 8 repetitions.

name: Down Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the reformer carriage with feet against the shoulder blocks, hands on the foot bar.
Press your hips forward, creating a long line from knees to head with a slight back extension.
Push the carriage back by bending through the upper body, hinging at the hips.
Pull the carriage forward by pressing hips through and lifting the chest.
Repeat for 6 to 8 repetitions.

name: Up Stretch
instructions: Stand on the reformer with hands on the foot bar and feet against the shoulder blocks, hips piked up.
Form an inverted V shape with your body.
Push the carriage back while maintaining the pike position.
Lower through a plank, then scoop the abs to return to the pike position.
Repeat for 5 to 8 repetitions.

name: Knee Stretches Round Back
instructions: Kneel on the carriage with hands on the foot bar, toes curled against the shoulder blocks.
Round your spine into a C-curve, tucking your pelvis and drawing your navel to your spine.
Press the carriage back with your legs while maintaining the rounded shape.
Pull the carriage back in using your abdominals.
Repeat for 10 repetitions.

name: Knee Stretches Flat Back
instructions: Kneel on the carriage with hands on the foot bar, toes against the shoulder blocks.
Maintain a flat, neutral spine with your back long and straight.
Press the carriage back by extending your hips and knees.
Pull back in with control, keeping the flat back position.
Repeat for 10 repetitions.

name: Reformer Running
instructions: Lie on the reformer with the balls of both feet on the foot bar, legs extended.
Bend one knee while lowering the opposite heel below the bar in a calf stretch.
Alternate feet in a running motion, pressing one heel down as the other rises.
Keep the carriage still and movement smooth and rhythmic.
Continue for 20 alternating repetitions.

name: Reformer Pelvic Lift
instructions: Lie on the reformer with feet on the foot bar in parallel position.
Peel your hips off the carriage into a bridge position.
While holding the bridge, press the carriage out by extending your legs.
Pull the carriage back in by bending your knees, maintaining the lifted hips.
Repeat 8 to 10 times, then roll the spine down.

name: Long Box Pulling Straps
instructions: Lie face down on the long box placed on the reformer, chest just past the edge.
Hold the straps with straight arms hanging down toward the floor.
Pull the straps back alongside your body, lifting your chest into extension.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the pull.
Return with control to the starting position. Repeat 6 to 8 times.

name: Short Box Round Back
instructions: Sit on the short box with feet secured under the foot strap, arms wrapped around your waist.
Round your spine into a deep C-curve.
Roll back, peeling your spine away from the box one vertebra at a time.
Go back as far as you can while maintaining the C-curve shape.
Curl back up to the seated position. Repeat 5 to 8 times.

name: Short Box Flat Back
instructions: Sit on the short box with feet under the strap, arms extended overhead or holding a bar.
Maintain a flat, tall spine.
Hinge back from the hips with the flat back, leaning as far as you can control.
Engage your core to pull yourself back up to the seated position.
Repeat 5 to 8 times.

name: Tendon Stretch
instructions: Stand on the reformer carriage facing the foot bar with hands on the foot bar, feet on the carriage edge.
Round your spine deeply and press your heels down toward the carriage.
Push the carriage back with your feet while keeping hands fixed on the bar.
Use your abdominals to pull the carriage back under you.
Repeat for 5 to 8 repetitions.

name: Long Spine Massage
instructions: Lie on the reformer with feet in the straps, legs extended at a 45-degree angle.
Press your legs toward the ceiling until they are vertical.
Continue lifting your hips and rolling through the spine until your body is inverted, supported by the straps.
Open your legs to shoulder width and slowly roll down through the spine one vertebra at a time.
Close your legs at the bottom and repeat 3 to 5 times.

name: Standing Roll Down
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides.
Nod your chin to your chest and begin rolling down through the spine vertebra by vertebra.
Let your arms hang heavy as you round forward, reaching toward the floor.
Allow a slight bend in the knees if needed.
Slowly reverse the movement, stacking your spine back up one vertebra at a time.

name: Standing Side Leg Lift
instructions: Stand tall with feet together, hands on hips or holding a support for balance.
Shift your weight to one leg and engage your core.
Lift the other leg out to the side, keeping it straight and toes facing forward.
Lift to a comfortable height without tilting your torso.
Lower with control and repeat 10 to 12 times per side.

name: Standing Leg Press
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg lifted in front of you, knee bent at 90 degrees.
Slowly bend the standing leg as if sitting back into a single-leg squat.
Press through the standing foot to return to the starting position.
Keep your core engaged and torso upright throughout.
Repeat 8 to 10 times per leg.

name: Standing Pilates Lunge
instructions: Stand with one foot forward and the other back in a split stance.
Bend both knees to lower into a lunge, keeping your front knee over your ankle.
Maintain a tall, lifted spine with shoulders over hips.
Press through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat 8 to 10 times per side.

name: Standing Spine Twist
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms extended to the sides at shoulder height.
Inhale to grow taller through the spine.
Exhale and rotate your torso to the right, keeping hips squared forward.
Inhale and return to center.
Exhale and rotate to the left. Repeat 6 to 8 times per side.

name: Standing Pilates Calf Raises
instructions: Stand in Pilates stance with heels together, toes slightly apart in a small V.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Hold at the top, squeezing your inner thighs together.
Lower down with control, maintaining the V position.
Repeat for 12 to 15 repetitions.

name: Standing Balance Leg Extension
instructions: Stand tall on one leg, lifting the other knee to hip height in front of you.
Slowly extend the lifted leg straight in front of you.
Hold for 2 to 3 seconds with the leg fully extended.
Bend the knee back to the starting position.
Repeat 8 times per side.

name: Standing Pilates Squat
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width apart, toes turned out at about 45 degrees.
Keep your spine tall and arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Squeeze your glutes and inner thighs as you press back up to standing.
Repeat for 10 to 12 repetitions.

name: Ball Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet resting on top of a stability ball, arms by your sides.
Press your feet into the ball and lift your hips off the mat into a bridge position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to feet.
Hold for 2 to 3 seconds.
Lower your hips back down with control. Repeat 10 to 12 times.

name: Ball Pike
instructions: Start in a plank position with your shins resting on a stability ball, hands under shoulders.
Engage your core and lift your hips up toward the ceiling, rolling the ball toward your hands.
Form an inverted V shape with your body, keeping your legs straight.
Hold briefly at the top.
Slowly lower back to the plank position. Repeat 8 to 10 times.

name: Ball Jackknife
instructions: Start in a plank position with your shins on a stability ball.
Bend your knees and roll the ball toward your chest, tucking your knees in.
Keep your shoulders stable over your wrists.
Extend your legs back out to the plank position with control.
Repeat for 10 to 12 repetitions.

name: Ball Plank
instructions: Place your forearms on a stability ball with your legs extended behind you in a plank position.
Engage your abdominals and maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Keep the ball as still as possible, resisting any rolling.
Hold the position for 30 to 60 seconds.
Rest and repeat 2 to 3 times.

name: Ball Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels resting on top of a stability ball, arms by your sides.
Lift your hips into a bridge position.
Bend your knees and roll the ball toward your glutes, keeping your hips lifted.
Extend your legs back out, rolling the ball away.
Repeat for 10 to 12 repetitions.

name: Ball Back Extension
instructions: Drape yourself over a stability ball face down, with your hips on the ball and feet anchored on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or crossed on your chest.
Lower your upper body down over the ball.
Lift your chest by extending your spine, squeezing your back muscles at the top.
Lower with control. Repeat 10 to 12 times.

name: Ball Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie sideways over a stability ball with your hip resting on the ball, feet staggered on the floor for balance.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lower your torso down over the side of the ball.
Crunch up sideways, lifting your torso by contracting your obliques.
Repeat 10 to 12 times per side.

name: Ball Roll Out
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your forearms resting on a stability ball in front of you.
Engage your core and slowly roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Keep your body in a straight line as you extend as far as you can control.
Use your abdominals to pull the ball back to the starting position.
Repeat for 8 to 10 repetitions.

name: Band Leg Press
instructions: Lie on your back with a resistance band looped around the arches of your feet, holding the ends in your hands.
Bring your knees to tabletop position.
Press your feet away from you, extending your legs at a 45-degree angle against the band resistance.
Slowly bend your knees back to the tabletop position.
Repeat for 10 to 12 repetitions.

name: Band Arm Circles
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band taut between both hands at shoulder width.
Raise your arms overhead with the band stretched.
Circle your arms forward and down, maintaining tension on the band.
Continue the circle back up to the starting position.
Repeat 8 circles forward, then 8 circles backward.

name: Supine Pelvic Curl
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the mat hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
Inhale to prepare.
Exhale and tilt your pelvis, pressing your lower back into the mat, then peel your spine off the mat one vertebra at a time.
Lift until you form a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Inhale at the top, then exhale and roll back down. Repeat 8 to 10 times.

name: Supine Toe Taps
instructions: Lie on your back with legs in tabletop position, knees bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the mat.
Slowly lower one foot toward the floor, tapping your toes lightly.
Lift the leg back to tabletop position.
Alternate legs for 10 to 12 repetitions per side.

name: Dead Bug Pilates
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and legs in tabletop position.
Press your lower back into the mat.
Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg forward, hovering above the floor.
Return to the starting position with control.
Alternate sides for 8 to 10 repetitions per side.

name: Dart
instructions: Lie face down with arms by your sides, palms facing up, legs together.
Inhale to prepare.
Exhale and lift your head, chest, and arms off the mat, reaching your fingertips toward your feet.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lengthen through the crown of your head.
Hold for a breath, then lower down. Repeat 6 to 8 times.

name: Cat Cow Pilates
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and arch your back, lifting your tailbone and head toward the ceiling for cow position.
Exhale and round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking your chin and pelvis for cat position.
Move slowly and articulate through each vertebra.
Repeat for 8 to 10 cycles.
